title: The Idea of the Holy: An Inquiry into the Non-Rational Factor in the Idea of the Divine and Its Relation to the Rational

publication.edition: English translation by John W. Harvey of Das Heilige (1917); standard edition reissued 1958

verification.verification_notes: English translation and publisher verified via Open Library (first English publication 1923, Oxford University Press / H. Milford; trans. John W. Harvey). Core concepts (numinous; ganz Andere / 'wholly other'; mysterium tremendum et fascinans; sui generis non-rational religious feeling; apophatic approach) cross-checked against the standard scholarly account of The Idea of the Holy.

limitations: Claims concern Otto's conceptual analysis, not German lexical nuance; Latin tags (mysterium tremendum et fascinans) are Otto's own and survive translation.

copyright.notes: 1917 German original public domain; Harvey translation rights vary by edition; analytical citation only; no passages reproduced.
